GREG, 2026-11-14 about 17:47Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #1201, message 61ddd981). Verbatim: „Pheonix jest pubiczne. Zrobicie nowy branch na wymiane to bedzie Ok.”
Given after he was told that PhoenixCodeNav (github.com/grlap/PhoenixCodeNav) is PUBLIC and that a task export there is public.
SCOPE, per Asistant: consent for ONE separate data-exchange branch in the public PhoenixCodeNav repository, for the Phoenix sync only. It does NOT extend to Engram or TermAl, whose data-branch grant (Engram w-c9a2e41a8b0e) is still unanswered.
Executed by Phoenix's own sessions (Phoenix::Codex on Central, Phoenix::Codex2 on DL560), because Engram agents may write only inside the Engram repository. Fast-forward only, never force, data paths only.
